criteria.frozen_criterion: margin_global_bits_per_decision <= 0.001 (one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the admission support)
criteria.statistic: one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the admission support

criteria.frozen_criterion: gain_sparse_bits_per_decision >= 0.167 on the pooled (rare_exact, exact_absent_in_domain) support
criteria.statistic: support-weighted mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over the pooled sparse strata
support-weighted expected calibration error of the hybrid channel over the pooled sparse strata
paired-by-hand hybrid-minus-active log-loss delta on the frequent_exact stratum, in point estimate and in paired 95% upper bound

criteria.frozen_criterion: abstain iff hard_reasons is not empty; abstain_rate on the synthetic out-of-domain probe surface == 1.0 and coverage == 0.0
criteria.statistic: measured abstention rate of the frozen router on the OOD probe surface

criteria_evaluation.outcome_rule: ADMIT_HYBRID_ROUTER_FOR_ANALYSIS iff every frozen criterion passes; otherwise RETAIN_REFERENCE_HYBRID_INSUFFICIENT

criteria.criterion: margin_global_bits_per_decision <= 0.001 (one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the admission support)
criteria.derivation_rule: ceil_to_quantum(max(MARGIN_MAX_BITS, one_sided_upper_quantile of the paired hybrid-minus-active bootstrap), MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS)

justification.statement: the margin is sized by the measured TRAIN out-of-fold dispersion: it is the smallest multiple of the preregistered 0.001-bit resolution that covers the observed one-sided 95% upper bound of the paired hybrid-minus-active loss difference, and the closed-form analytic margin reproduces it within the preregistered tolerance
justification.statistic: one-sided upper percentile of the paired-by-hand bootstrap of mean(log_loss_hybrid - log_loss_active) on the TRAIN out-of-fold admission support

criteria.criterion: gain_sparse_bits_per_decision >= 0.167 on the pooled (rare_exact, exact_absent_in_domain) support
criteria.derivation_rule: max(GAIN_FLOOR_BITS, floor_to_quantum(support_weighted_mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS))

rounding.rationale: the floor is the gain TRAIN already demonstrated, rounded down to the preregistered resolution so the requirement is never stricter than the measured evidence

justification.statement: the minimal sparse gain required of the router is the level the TRAIN out-of-fold evidence already demonstrates on the two strata the generalized channel may cover
justification.statistic: support-weighted mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain on the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.derivation_rule: min(ECE_ABSOLUTE_CEILING, ece_active_sparse + ECE_DELTA_CEILING) with ece_active_sparse the support-weighted active-reference ECE on the sparse strata

justification.statement: the frozen ceiling is the tighter of the preregistered absolute ECE ceiling and the active reference's own sparse ECE plus the preregistered delta; the recorded term name shows which of the two binds
justification.statistic: support-weighted expected calibration error over rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, measured on the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.derivation_rule: max(FREQUENT_EXACT_MAX_DEGRADATION_BITS, ceil_to_quantum(max(point estimate, one-sided upper quantile, ci95 upper) of the paired hybrid-minus-active loss on frequent_exact, MARGIN_ANALYTIC_TOLERANCE_BITS))

justification.statement: the frequent-exact route may not degrade the active reference beyond the bound derived from the paired dispersion of that stratum, in point estimate and in paired upper quantile
justification.statistic: paired-by-hand hybrid-minus-active log-loss delta on the frequent_exact stratum of the TRAIN out-of-fold decisions

criteria.criterion: abstain iff hard_reasons is not empty; abstain_rate on the synthetic out-of-domain probe surface == 1.0 and coverage == 0.0
criteria.derivation_rule: abstain(c) iff reasons(c) intersect OOD_HARD_REASONS is not empty; the soft reason set may only raise the status to high uncertainty, never to abstention

justification.statement: the router must fail closed on every out-of-domain probe: the frozen criterion requires a complete abstention on the probe surface, with the hard reason codes decisive and the soft reasons never abstaining
justification.statistic: measured abstention rate of the frozen router on the synthetic out-of-domain probe surface of the TRAIN cross-validation

limper_vs_iso.definition: the limper-versus-isolation family, reported on its own surface so the pooled strata tables never hide it

active_model_a.by_stratum_note: held-out TRAIN decisions only; the OOD stratum's synthetic-probe surface is published in per_stratum and ood_synthetic_probes
active_model_a.definition: frozen combo-weighted public action marginal of active Model A v5, mapped onto the four response actions

generalized_calibrated.by_stratum_note: held-out TRAIN decisions only; the OOD stratum's synthetic-probe surface is published in per_stratum and ood_synthetic_probes
generalized_calibrated.definition: the #421 response architecture fitted on the fold's fit rows, recalibrated in-fold with the #423 T2 method and read out-of-fold

hybrid_router.by_stratum_note: held-out TRAIN decisions only; the OOD stratum's synthetic-probe surface is published in per_stratum and ood_synthetic_probes
hybrid_router.definition: the #423 T3 route decision: active reference on strong exact support, calibrated generalized channel on sparse in-domain support, abstain otherwise

ood_synthetic_probes.definition: synthetic out-of-domain probes perturbing a fold's fit rows into a never-seen category (the frozen OOD stratum) or past the calibrated numeric envelope (a hard extrapolation reason); the router must fail closed on every one of them

active_model_a_minus_generalized_calibra.definition: mean per-decision base-2 log-loss delta of the left channel minus the right channel, paired by hand_id, over the decisions both channels answer

hybrid_router_minus_active_model_a.definition: mean per-decision base-2 log-loss delta of the left channel minus the right channel, paired by hand_id, over the decisions both channels answer

hybrid_router_minus_generalized_calibrat.definition: mean per-decision base-2 log-loss delta of the left channel minus the right channel, paired by hand_id, over the decisions both channels answer

probe_block.definition: synthetic out-of-domain probes perturbing a fold's fit rows into a never-seen category (the frozen OOD stratum) or past the calibrated numeric envelope (a hard extrapolation reason); the router must fail closed on every one of them

metrics.baseline_log_loss_bits_per_decision: same loss under the fit-fold action prior
metrics.brier_score: mean sum over the four actions of (P(action) - 1[observed])^2
metrics.coverage: share of decisions the channel answers with a legal, non-abstaining distribution
metrics.expected_calibration_error: equal-count reliability bins per action class (frozen T2 definition of tools/training/validate_hierarchical_validation.py::expected_calibration_error): for each action, sort rows by predicted probability, cut 10 equal-count bins, accumulate bin-mass-weighted |mean predicted - mean observed| and average over the four action classes
metrics.log_loss_bits_per_decision: mean -log2 P(observed action), base-2 bits per decision

no_leak.assertion: assert not (holdout_hands_i & train_hands_i) for every fold i, and assert the holdout hand sets partition the hand universe

ood_probes.source: synthetic perturbations of the fold's fit rows

route_rule.definition: the frozen preregistered table: abstain on any hard OOD reason; answer from the active model on strong exact support; use the sparse channel only when every single-feature label stays in domain; abstain otherwise

sparse_strata_comparison.definition: direct, per-stratum comparison of the active Model A reference, the calibrated generalized channel and the hybrid router on the two sparse strata, with the support-weighted pool the frozen sparse criteria read

SPARSE_ECE_CEILING.statistic: support-weighted expected calibration error of the hybrid channel over the pooled sparse strata

SPARSE_GAIN_FLOOR.frozen_criterion: gain_sparse_bits_per_decision >= 0.167 on the pooled (rare_exact, exact_absent_in_domain) support
SPARSE_GAIN_FLOOR.statistic: support-weighted mean of the hybrid channel's gain_bits_per_decision over the pooled sparse strata

sparse_strata_comparison.title: #423 T6 sparse strata comparison: rare_exact and exact_absent_in_domain, the two strata the generalized channel may cover

strata.definition: frozen #423 strata: frequent_exact (exact-cell support >= 20), rare_exact (0 < support < 20), exact_absent_in_domain (support == 0, every single-feature label observed in the fit fold) and exact_absent_out_of_domain (support == 0 with at least one unseen feature value)

title: #423 T6 terminal score: the cross-fitted TRAIN comparison judged by the frozen numeric admission criteria
